history.summary: Added HTTP prompt queue endpoints to the viewer server
Updated README.md to reflect new MCP tools, resources, and prompt queue feature
Added compact session context MCP resource for token-efficient architecture retrieval
Added git hook installer and CLI command for auto-reconcile on post-commit

Recovered four decisions orphaned by the archlearn->arkive path migration: moved the stale root architecture.json to arkive/legacy-architecture.json (see docs/legacy-architecture.md) and un-ignored docs/, which had prevented the Plan 1-6 documents from ever being committed

Moved the viewer's bearer-token handoff out of a server-injected script that monkey-patched window.fetch and into the viewer itself (src/viewer/src/api/auth.ts); open_viewer now returns a fragment URL carrying the run token (docs/issues/0017-close-auth-followups.md)
